_comment: Paths relative to this config file. dataset_root must contain RASTER/IMG-TIFF/16-BIT/. Each key under 'algorithms' is a benchmark_id; its 'method' field names the actual technique (looked up in scripts/segment.py:ALGO_FUNCS), mirroring the ML pipeline's benchmark_id/model_name split.

BASELINE_CLASSICAL._comment: Felzenszwalb graph-based segmentation then dark-segment threshold. scale: larger = larger segments. dark_percentile: segments below this mean-intensity percentile are flagged. Selected as the sole classical baseline (2026-07-08) after comparing all 7 originally implemented candidates against ground truth. dark_percentile changed 30->15 on 2026-09-11 after scripts/sweep_dark_percentile.py showed 15 beats 30 on pixel IoU (0.292 vs 0.275) — see the 'Parameter sensitivity' section in README.md and results/dark_percentile_sweep.csv.
